analysis.summary: Accent Microcell reported growth in FY26 driven by premium product exports, specifically MCC spheres and SMCC. The company is currently awaiting regulatory approvals for its Unit 3, which will be commissioned in phases to expand capacity for premium excipients and MCC. Management noted that trading activities were utilized to maintain customer relationships but expects these to decrease as new manufacturing capacity comes online. The company maintains a positive outlook on demand and expects blended profit margins to improve as the product mix shifts toward higher-value offerings. Accent Microcell Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the half year and year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting strong growth in revenue and profitability.

guidance.claim: The company projected ₹70 crore revenue in Year 1 for its capacity expansion project.
Management expects a CAGR of 15 to 20% for the company over the next 3 to 5 years.
guidance.quote: Just a moment, sir, at least say 15 to 20% CAGR for next 3 to 5 years. We are expecting.

guidance.claim: Management estimates a capacity utilization of around 60% for the first year of operation for Unit 3 Phase 1.
guidance.quote: Sir. Look into the various guidelines in place. I won't be able to quantify in terms of financial figure, but yes, from the from current fiscal given a full year capacity, we are expecting it to be utility level, to be around 60% for the 1st year.

guidance.claim: Management states that capacity utilization for Phase 2 for the entire year will be around 70%, translating to roughly 50 to 55% for that particular financial year.
guidance.quote: Yes, sir, that needs to be read with the 70%. What I have said is for the entire year. So accordingly, for 9 months. We need to derive the roughly, the capacity will be around 50 to 55 percentage for that particular financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: The current demand outlook for MCC is positive based on the existing order book.
demand_outlook.quote: So, currency, current, MCC demand outlook is good, taking into account our existing order book.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has approximately 4,000 metric tons of orders on hand.
demand_outlook.quote: Taking into account, say, domestic and export market, we have roughly around, 4,000 metric tons orders on hand with us.

demand_outlook.claim: The global microcrystalline cellulose market is expanding at a CAGR of approximately 7.8%.
Management observed an increase in product inquiries in the oral pharma and particular segments.
demand_outlook.quote: If we look into the oral pharma and particular segment where we have been supplying the product range, so, of course is, there has been product. Inquiry has been increased, and we have been taking care of the business from our business side.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that the global market size of microcrystalline cellulose is around 2,50,000 metric tons.
demand_outlook.quote: I mean, see in terms of revenue. I cannot give you any idea at this moment, but in terms of quantity we are identified that the total of MCC. As such, is around 2,50,000 metric ton.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that the Indian domestic market size for microcrystalline cellulose is 50,000 metric tons per annum.
demand_outlook.quote: We have 2.5 lakh is globally 50,000 metric ton for the Indian market.

capex_expansion.claim: Unit 3 is being developed in phases, with Phase 1 for premium excipients and Phase 2 for MCC.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 will cater to, say, a premium range of excipient products, and Phase 2 will cater to MCC.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has purchased land sufficient for expansion up to Phase 6.
capex_expansion.quote: Good question Mr. Priyank, we have purchased land for till phase 6.

capex_expansion.claim: Management states that Phase 1 of Unit 3 will have a capacity of 2,400 metric tons per annum at 100% capacity utilization.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, sir, phase one at 100% capacity utilization. It will be around 2,400 metric ton per annum and phase 2 will be 12,000 metric ton

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to commence commercial production for Unit 3 Phase 1 by the end of October or the first couple of weeks of November.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, sir. By say, quarter 3 of the current financial year. So anywhere between, say by the end of October or in the 1st couple of weeks of November.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects Unit 3 Phase 2 to come on stream in July 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Sir, we're expecting it to be in the month of say, July 2,026.

capex_expansion.claim: Management states that the cost for Unit 3 Phase 2 is around Rs. 55 to 60 crores, except the value of land.
capex_expansion.quote: Sir, I hope you are referring to Capex, or phase 2. Yes. Phase 2. Correct. Yes, sir, it is around 55 to 60 crore, except the value of land.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported a gross profit margin of approximately 38%.
margins_costs.quote: So, gross profit percentage is around 38%, so I guess, more or less, your concern, or rather, the question will be answered through that percentage.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects blended profit margins to increase by 2-3% as the product mix shifts to premium offerings.
margins_costs.quote: It will be prudent enough to assume going ahead, as we are going ahead with more premium range of products, so it is prudent enough to assume that the blended profit margins are going to increase by, say, at least 2-3 percentage.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin for FY26 was reported at 12.57%.
Management states that the price of CCS is around 3.5 times of MCC.
margins_costs.quote: The price of CC. CCS is around 3.5 times of MCC.

margins_costs.claim: Management states that new premium excipient products lead to roughly a 5 to 7 percentage increase in the sales of finished goods.
margins_costs.quote: roughly, you can say around say, 5 to 7 percentage say, increase in the sales of finished goods because of the new range that we have started selling off

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved a total sales volume of 15,000 metric tons in FY26.
Pirana Unit I has an installed capacity of 2,000 MTPA and operates at 100% capacity utilisation.
Dahej SEZ Unit II has an installed capacity of 7,200 MTPA and operates at 95% capacity utilisation.
Management states the company currently has business on hand for about 4 to 5 months.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, we have at present about, you can say for 4 to 5 months. We have business on hand

orders_capacity.claim: Management states the current installed capacity is 9,600 metric tons.

capital_allocation.claim: Phase 2 expansion will be funded through a rights issue and internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: Because Phase 2, Phase 2, we are going to fund it out from right issue, and to a certain extent, internal equals.

risks_headwinds.claim: The delay in Unit 3 commercialization was caused by abnormal monsoons and regulatory licensing requirements.
risks_headwinds.quote: The delay in Phase 1 was, primarily due to two reasons, two back-to-back abnormal monsoons, and, certain licensing work, read with, say, regulatory approvals that was required, being, project treated as, greenfield.

risks_headwinds.claim: The implementation schedule for Unit-III has been re-aligned owing to two consecutive abnormal monsoon seasons impacting on-site execution activities.
risks_headwinds.quote:
Two consecutive abnormal monsoon seasons
impacting on-site execution activities

risks_headwinds.claim: Extended liaisoning timelines for obtaining required regulatory approvals also affected the Unit-III implementation schedule.
risks_headwinds.quote:
Extended liaisoning timelines for obtaining the
required regulatory approvals

management_commitments.claim: Phase 1 of Unit 3 is expected to start commercial production within one month following the receipt of pending licenses.
management_commitments.quote: Only need GPCV license and pollution control license. Will get the license by one month so phase 1 will start.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to start Phase 3 of the expansion in 2028.
management_commitments.quote: Almost in 2028 will start the Phase 3.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects Unit 3 Phase 1 to commercialize by the end of October or in the first few weeks of November of the current year.
management_commitments.quote: So we have already the required approach in place. So we are expecting it to be commercialized, say, by say, as I stated earlier, by the end of October or in the few 1st few weeks of November current year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the trial run for Unit 3 Phase 2 to commence in July 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, trial run will commence from say, July 26, as I was stated earlier.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
